title: Guest baseline set
description: The defense baselines a guest can be given (ADR-0016, docs/compute-model.md). `controls` is the catalogue of generic, product-neutral defense controls, each in exactly one defense-in-depth layer, each with a human-readable `verify` observable and the Ansible `role` that implements it (null = no product chosen yet; the product is bound here and nowhere else). `baselines` are named sets of controls; a baseline may extend others. Lives as `_baselines.yml` next to the guest files; consumed by homelabnext.compute.

layer.description: The one defense-in-depth layer the control belongs to: identity (who can get in), host (the operating system itself), network (what traffic may flow), detection (seeing attacks and weaknesses), data (protecting what is stored), recovery (getting back after a loss).

role.description: The Ansible role that implements the control, applied to the control_<id> inventory group. null = the product is not chosen yet; the baseline-playbook target lists it as unbound, never drops it.

verify.description: How you would prove the control is in place on a guest (a human-readable observable).

extends.description: Baselines whose controls this one includes (resolved parents first).
